card.title: Composure on Loan
card.instruction: Project steady control while quietly depending on everyone else to stay calm enough for you to maintain it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll chair the delivery meeting. We're in control. Keep your voice just there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The van's missing. I'm trying not to panic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Keep trying. We'll establish its last location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fetch the driver. He's shouting in the corridor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brief him outside first. Then sit beside me and give the report in your voice.
